identity.kind: plastic water drum (IBC-style drum/barrel, single drum)

claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Photos show a blue plastic drum with lid/cap but do not confirm it is empty.

risks.risk: Capacity/size is not clearly readable; price depends heavily on whether it’s a small drum vs a larger capacity drum.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full molded/printed capacity marking (e.g., liters/volume) on the side or base, taken straight-on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used plastic water drum with unknown capacity (worst-case: smaller/less valuable size).

risks.risk: Condition inside/outside (leaks, cracks, odor/contamination) cannot be confirmed from these photos.
risks.proof: A short video showing the drum filled with water (or a leak test) and a close-up of the bottom and seams.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing cleaning and with possible minor defects (worst-case: treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Lid/cap integrity (fit, gasket/washer condition) affects usability for water storage.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the red cap/plug and the underside of the lid, plus a photo showing it seated properly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the cap/lid may not seal perfectly (worst-case: assume replacement/extra work may be needed).

proof_requests: Send a clear straight-on photo of the drum’s capacity/volume marking (liters) on the side/base.
Send a close-up of the bottom and any seams/edges for cracks or warping.
Send a short leak test video (fill with water briefly and show no dripping).
Send a close-up of the red cap/plug and lid underside to confirm sealing condition.
response.reason: It’s clearly a plastic water drum, but the key pricing drivers (exact capacity and leak/condition confirmation) aren’t verifiable from the photos, so a worst-case price can’t be set confidently without the missing markings and a leak/fit check.
